description: SUM and AVG over a VARIANT column return DOUBLE even for whole-number JSON values - live-verified, SUM of PARSE_JSON('1') and PARSE_JSON('2') is 3.0 with SYSTEM$TYPEOF reporting FLOAT. INSERT ... VALUES rejects semi-structured expressions, so the fixture is populated with INSERT ... SELECT. Converted 1:1 from functions/SumVariantTest (now retired); the Java asserted the runtime object was a Double, and SYSTEM$TYPEOF is the SQL instrument for the same claim - the one the class's own docstring names as the live one - so the suite reads that, matching on the FLOAT prefix because each backend appends its own size suffix. The other instruments do NOT show it: TYPEOF(TO_VARIANT(SUM(v))) answers INTEGER because TO_VARIANT normalises a whole double, a CTAS column materialises as NUMBER, and the value renders as 3 rather than 3.0.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO vt SELECT PARSE_JSON('1') UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_JSON('2')
INSERT INTO vt SELECT PARSE_JSON('1') UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_JSON('2')
